title: Altius Telecom Q2FY27 Results: Adjusted revenue up 3.7%, NAV rises to ₹175.12 Adjusted revenue for H1FY27 rose 3.6% YoY to ₹63,208 million, while cash EBITDA grew 5.3% to ₹43,357 million. NAV increased to ₹175.12 per unit, as deferred tax asset recognition offset the impact of a 40 bps rise in the risk-free rate. Distribution per unit for H1FY27 stood at ₹8.03, with cumulative distributions since inception reaching ₹85.7 per unit. Management cited an estimated market opportunity of 350,000 incremental tenancies over the next five years. Net borrowings ratio remained conservative at 44.86%, significantly below the 70% regulatory ceiling
